title: Chapter I
chineseTitle: 第 1 章：吞噬大象的巨蟒

paragraphs.en: When I was six, I saw a picture in a book about a boa constrictor swallowing an animal whole. Inspired by this, I drew my first masterpiece, depicting the inside of a boa digesting an elephant.
paragraphs.zh: 六岁那年，我看到一本书里有一张关于 boa 狄斯科蛇吞下整只动物的图片。受此启发，我画出了自己的第一幅杰作，描绘了boa蛇消化一头大象的内部景象。

paragraphs.en: I showed these drawings to grown-ups but received only puzzled responses. They asked why they should be frightened by hats instead of understanding my artwork. Discouraged, I decided to focus on subjects like geography and arithmetic rather than painting.
paragraphs.zh: 我把这些画给大人看，却只得到了困惑的回应。他们不解地问我，为什么会被帽子吓到而不是理解我的作品。受挫之下，我决定将注意力转向地理和算术这类科目，而非绘画。

paragraphs.en: This decision led me to become a pilot, traveling the world and finding that geographical knowledge was indeed useful. Despite this, my experiences with grown-ups did not change my negative opinion of them.
paragraphs.zh: 这个决定让我成为一名飞行员，环游世界，发现地理知识确实很有用。尽管如此，我对成人的经历并没有改变我对其负面的看法。

paragraphs.en: Whenever I encountered someone who appeared insightful, I tested them with my Drawing Number One. They always replied, "That is a hat." To prove their understanding, I then discussed mundane topics like bridge, golf, politics, and neckties.
paragraphs.zh: 每当我遇到看似见解独到的人，我都会用我的第一招测试他们。他们总是回答：“那是一顶帽子。”为了证明他们的理解能力，我随后会讨论一些平凡的话题，比如桥牌、高尔夫、政治和领带。

paragraphs.en: The grown-ups were delighted to find such a sensible companion.
paragraphs.zh: 大人发现有个如此理智的同伴非常高兴。
